title: Vehicle leasing - federal disclosure basics
facts: The federal Consumer Leasing Act and Regulation M require disclosures for covered consumer vehicle leases.
Required disclosures include information such as amounts due at lease signing, payment schedule, other charges, total payments and certain end-of-lease obligations.
A lease payment is not directly comparable to a loan payment without considering acquisition costs, mileage limits, disposition fees, purchase option and end-of-lease charges.
Mileage limits and excess-mileage charges are contractual terms and vary by lease.
